jobs.title: Client Associate
jobs.description:
The Client Associate will act in an Executive Assistant (EA) capacity serving as the operational backbone of the team, ensuring seamless execution of administrative, client-facing, and marketing initiatives. This role requires a proactive and detail-oriented professional who embodies our core values – relentless optimization, growth, thoughtfulness, exceptional client experience, and entrepreneurial mindset – while supporting the team in delivering exceptional wealth management services.

Coordinate and maintain the team’s master calendar, ensuring efficient time allocation for internal priorities and client meetings.
• Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them.

Expense & Budget Administration
• Process and submit business expenses in accordance with compliance and corporate policies.
• Track team budget allocations, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.

Travel Coordination
• Plan, coordinate, and execute travel coordination for team members to meet with clients across the country.
Marketing & Digital Presence
• Maintain and update the team’s marketing materials to ensure accuracy and alignment with brand standards.
• Oversee website and LinkedIn presence, posting timely updates and managing content calendars.

Events & Engagement
• Plan, coordinate, and execute client appreciation events from concept to completion.
• Manage our client gifting. Year-end holiday gifting, big life moments, and milestone birthdays.

jobs.title: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team

titleByLocale.en: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team
titleByLocale.it: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team
titleByLocale.de: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team
titleByLocale.fr: Risk and Liquidity Manager – Investment Management Team

jobs.description:
The Risk and Liquidity Manager is a critical member of the House View and OCIO teams, responsible for overseeing investment risk and liquidity management across diversified, multi-asset class portfolios. The House View portfolios are the core offerings to wealth management clients, while the OCIO portfolios serve a sophisticated institutional client base, including endowments, foundations, retirement plans, and ultra-high-net-worth families. This role supports the firm’s risk governance framework, delivers actionable insights to portfolio team, and ensures investment strategies align with client objectives and risk tolerances.

• Lead the identification, measurement, and monitoring of portfolio and aggregate client risk exposures, including market, credit, factor, interest rate, inflation, & currency risks.
• Design and implement forward-looking liquidity projections and stress testing across portfolios, incorporating both public and private market exposures.
• Manage selection, implementation, setup and testing of risk and analytics systems
• Develop and maintain risk analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools for use by House View portfolio managers, OCIO leadership, and client stakeholders.
• Conduct scenario analysis, value-at-risk (VaR), and tail-risk assessments using internal and third-party risk systems.
• Monitor redemption terms, lockups, and gating risks of underlying fund investments to ensure alignment with client liquidity needs and spending policies.
• Create liquidity models based on client/institutional spending needs and portfolio liquidity availability
• Serve as a subject matter expert in client meetings, delivering tailored risk and liquidity insights and supporting new client onboarding with modeling and analysis.
• Collaborate with investment and compliance teams to refine risk policies, investment guidelines, and portfolio construction parameters.
• Prepare and present risk reports to internal investment committees, audit and compliance teams, and client boards as needed
• Partner with technology, operations, and analytics teams to enhance risk reporting platforms, data pipelines, and ensure data integrity.
• Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory developments, and emerging risks relevant to institutional portfolios.

jobs.title: Payment Investigator
jobs.description:
Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. This role ensures timely, accurate settlement and strict compliance with Federal Reserve, Reg CC, and internal bank policies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve client inquiries related to payment issues, including sanctions holds, returned funds, and payment cancellations.
• Monitor and manage payment queues, ensuring timely resolution of flagged or delayed transactions.
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Compliance, Operations, Risk) to resolve complex cases and escalate issues when necessary.
• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

jobs.title: Head of Tax, Greater China
jobs.description:
Do you have a tax background in financial services or a chartered accountancy or law firm? Do you have a knack for breaking down complex issues to reach clear and concise conclusions? Are you able to interact with senior stakeholders and regulators? We’re looking for someone with tax expertise to help us:

• provide tax advice to the business divisions including Investment Bank, Asset Management and Global Wealth Management across UBS in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Korea regarding new business and change initiatives and complex transactions
• monitor tax reform issues impacting UBS
• interact effectively with senior management and staff across the different areas within the organisation
• manage relationships with tax authorities
• review tax effect accounting calculations and workpapers. This includes annual statutory reporting, and quarterly local and Swiss reporting
• work with the external service provider and Finance in supporting the annual corporate income tax process. Review the annual corporate income tax returns for all legal entities, including all disclosures, for the legal entities in jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review, update and compile the income tax manuals as required
• review the annual transfer pricing documentation for the jurisdictions under your responsibility
• review the annual local files under country by country reporting rules
• provide technical tax support into the wider APAC tax team where required, including supporting sign off to APAC Regional Tax for business advisory and new business initiatives

jobs.description:
Are you a strategic leader with a deep understanding of investment banking and a passion for driving business performance? UBS is seeking an Investment Banking Coverage & Advisory Management Director to help lead and optimize our Coverage & Advisory platform.

In this role, you will work closely with senior bankers and product partners to shape business strategy, enhance execution across coverage teams, and drive operational excellence. You will serve as a key partner to senior leadership, helping to manage and scale the business while maintaining a strong focus on client delivery and revenue growth.

Your responsibilities:

- Partner with senior Coverage & Advisory leadership to define and execute strategic priorities across industry teams
- Oversee business management activities, including pipeline monitoring, revenue tracking, budgeting, and resource allocation
- Drive coordination across coverage and product partners (M&A, ECM, DCM, LevFin) to ensure efficient transaction execution
- Support and influence origination efforts by identifying trends, client opportunities, and sector-level insights
- Lead key initiatives to improve processes, enhance productivity, and optimize team performance
- Manage senior stakeholder relationships across the Investment Bank, including Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance
- Provide leadership and oversight to junior team members, supporting talent development and workflow management
- Contribute to client materials and high-priority transactions as needed, ensuring quality and alignment with UBS standards
- Support regulatory and governance requirements associated with the Coverage & Advisory business

jobs.description:
Do you thrive on solving complex challenges, innovating beyond the expected, and influencing stakeholders across regions and cultures?

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Risk Partner (BRP) to join our Business Risk Organization (BRO) within the GWM Marketing business unit. You will be the driving force behind embedding smart, pragmatic, and future ready risk management across our US & LatAm marketing activities.

In this role you will:

• Lead BRP coverage for GWM Marketing US and LatAm, partnering closely with the Regional Head to oversee risk in regional marketing initiatives (risk briefings, deep dives, process enhancements, escalations).
• Champion strong governance, ensuring timely and accurate reporting in line with GWM frameworks, operating controls, and risk reporting requirements.
• Be the go to advisor for day to day risk topics, offering sharp, practical guidance; challenging the status quo; and anticipating risks in marketing processes and projects.
• Drive impact oriented change, contributing to ad hoc projects that enhance frameworks, controls, and operating models.
• Collaborate across borders and functions, including Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Audit, and second line of defense partners to co create pragmatic, business forward solutions.

jobs.title: IB Digital Assets Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of capital markets through Digital Assets and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)? Do you want to help define and scale regulated, institutional digital asset products and services across a global Investment Bank? We’re looking for a Product Manager to join the IB Digital Assets (Products & Services) team. In this role, you will shape and deliver the Investment Bank’s digital assets agenda, translating the potential of digital assets and DLT-based business models into scalable products, services, and business models embedded within and alongside core IB businesses.

We’re looking for a Digital Assets-focused Product Manager to:

• act as end to end Product Manager for defined Digital Assets products, services, and DLT based business models across the Investment Bank
• own the pipeline and roadmap for assigned Digital Assets products, services, and business models, from ideation and prioritisation through to pilot/MVP execution and handover to Change SMEs for scaling and BAU adoption
• originate, structure, and progress business cases for IB Digital Assets pilots and MVPs, including value proposition, economics, risks, dependencies, and success metrics
• partner closely with Front Office, Financing, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology to enable IB Digital Assets pilots/MVPs in existing IB workflows and operating models
• evaluate internal and external digital/DLT capabilities to determine optimal build, buy, partner, or reuse strategies based on feasibility, maturity, cost, and time to market
• appraise future state IB business and operating models required to scale Digital Assets products and services within IB and Group control frameworks
• act as a senior point of contact and thought partner, engaging internal stakeholders and selected external participants to shape IB positioning, partnerships, and market developments

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Fioneer Financial Control (FC) functional consultant to support the implementation and optimization of the financial control process. The role requires a strong blend of functional expertise, stakeholder engagement, and SAP product knowledge to translate business requirements into effective solutions. The position will play a critical role in driving the design, implementation and adoption of the Fioneer financial control module, while ensuring alignment with broader SAP finance architecture.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and support the implementation of SAP Fioneer Financial control module, including requirement gathering, solution design and deployment.
• Engage with business stakeholders to understand financial control requirements, pain points, and improvement opportunities.
• Translate business needs into functional specifications and solution designs
• Provide subject matter expertise on financial control processes (reconciliation, substantiation, reporting)
• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure accurate system configuration and integration.
• Evaluate existing processes and recommend best practices and optimization opportunities.
• Support UAT, training, and post implementation stabilization.
• Support the transition from legacy financial control systems to SAP Fioneer financial control including process assessment, gap analysis and migration support.
• Partner with vendor to drive co-innovation and solution enhancements aligned and business and control requirements.
• Act as a bridge between business and IT teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
• Provide inputs on data models, controls, and governance frameworks related to financial control.

Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets?
Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?

• Analyzing instances of potentially suspicious activities flagged by our systems.
• Engaging with business stakeholders on the market conduct-related escalations and other matters.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Digital Capabilities
jobs.description:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization? Are you enthusiastic about the future of working in an AI driven world?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to:

• Co-develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out agentic capabilities in our core platforms.
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that can benefit from AI tooling
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Keep current with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI / ML space, and apply external perspectives and insights to improve our offering
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

jobs.title: Team Lead Lombard Lending & Deposits
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned lending professional with deep Lombard expertise and a strong sense of ownership? Do you enjoy leading people while remaining hands on in complex transactions and strategic initiatives?
We are looking for a Director – Team Lead Lombard Lending & Deposits to lead the delivery of secured lending and deposits solutions in Taiwan. This is a senior role combining client-facing origination, product ownership and line management responsibility, with accountability for business growth, risk stewardship and people development.
In this role, you will be accountable for:
Lombard Lending Origination & Structuring
• act as the senior subject matter expert for Lombard lending in Taiwan, supporting Client Advisors and clients across the end to end financing lifecycle
• originate, structure and execute complex and bespoke Lombard lending transactions
o act as transaction lead for higher-risk or strategically important cases
o provide subject matter expertise and guidance for smaller/ less complex transactions
• develop and promote leverage solutions to client advisors to generate client interest and leverage demand
• drive sales momentum and conversion by identifying lending opportunities within existing and new client relationships
• provide expert guidance on pricing, leverage, structuring and risk trade offs, ensuring appropriate and sustainable use of credit
• participate in selected direct client interactions alongside Client Advisors to support origination, execution and client education
Deposits Business Ownership & Pricing
• serve as the local functional owner for the deposits business in Taiwan, with responsibility for product oversight, pricing discipline and commercial outcomes
• perform deposit pricing and balance sheet analysis, supporting business decisions and sales initiatives
• design and drive deposit sales campaigns in close partnership with control functions and frontline leadership
• liaise with Group Treasury and Investment Banking on funding considerations, pricing frameworks and group balance sheet preferences
• ensure clear and consistent communication of deposit strategy, pricing guidance and constraints to the business
People & Line Management
• line manage, coach and develop two team members, setting clear objectives and supporting their professional growth
• allocate deal responsibilities and product tasks appropriately, ensuring high-quality execution and knowledge transfer
• foster a strong team culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, risk awareness and client focus
• provide structured feedback, performance input and career guidance in line with UBS people principles
Product, Risk & Control Responsibilities
• maintain ownership of the local Lombard and deposits product shelf, including product maintenance, governance and pricing frameworks
• ensure compliance with local regulation and UBS internal policies, fulfilling first-line risk management responsibilities
• oversee portfolio monitoring, reporting and issue remediation in partnership with Risk, Legal and Compliance
• stay abreast of market developments, competitor activity and regulatory change, proactively adapting local offerings
Strategy, Change & Stakeholder Management
• develop and execute local lending and deposits growth strategies aligned with regional and global objectives
• contribute to new product development and enhancement initiatives with Global Lending distribution teams
• act as the local interface with IT and change teams on system enhancements, process improvements and digitisation initiatives
• collaborate extensively across Wealth Management, Credit Risk, Investments and Banking to deliver integrated client solutions

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant & Office Coordinator is critical to ensuring the effective coordination of executive priorities and day-to-day office operations. The position requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment.

This is an in-office role based in the Salt Lake City headquarters and requires regular on-site presence to support business and leadership needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Office Operations & Coordination
• Serve as a key operational contact for the UBS Bank USA Salt Lake City headquarters office.
• Coordinate office operations, including visitor management, seating arrangements, executive meeting logistics, and general administrative support.
• Partner with Facilities, Security, and the Salt Lake City management team to ensure smooth and efficient office operations.
• Support broader office management activities, including oversight of supplies, equipment, and workspace organization.

Executive & Governance Support
• Provide administrative support to the Head of Governance, including calendar management, meeting preparation, and coordination of priorities.
• Coordinate management committee and governance-related meetings, including scheduling, attendee tracking, materials preparation, and logistics, as needed.

Meetings, Events & Executive Engagement
• Assist in planning and coordinating onsite leadership meetings, town halls, and executive visits.
• Provide on-site support for the visiting senior executives (CEO, President), ensuring a seamless experience during visits to Salt Lake City.

Administrative & Operational Support
• Manage procurement requests, including approval and coordination of office supplies and equipment purchasing.
• Coordinate travel arrangements and expense reporting for the Head of Governance.
• Maintain and administer filing systems (electronic and manual), ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational policies.
• Handle incoming communications, including calls and mail, with professionalism and discretion.
Perform and coordinate routine and specialized administrative tasks as needed to support business priorities

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about applying quantitative methods to real-world investment challenges? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your portfolio construction skills and analytical thinking can drive innovation in portfolio risk management?

We’re looking for someone who can:

• Perform and document comprehensive reviews of discretionary investment strategies managed by U.S. Financial Advisors (FAs), with a detailed focus on investment process, dispersion analysis, performance, trading implementation, and related operational controls.
• Engage Financial Advisor (FA) teams to explain Investment Manager Analysis (IMA) observations and provide targeted coaching designed to strengthen their investment decision-making and drive improved long-term portfolio outcomes.
• Contribute to recurring governance meetings/committees for discretionary strategies; set agendas, curate materials, coordinate key stakeholders, and ensure decisions, actions, owners, and timelines are clearly captured; drive escalations and follow ups to closure.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for our discretionary programs; field questions from FA teams and cross functional partners, providing timely, well supported guidance on program design, oversight standards, and best practices.
• Participate in evolving the strategic vision for discretionary programs to ensure robust oversight and governance frameworks while preserving each FA’s ability to effectively navigate and manage discretionary portfolios.
• Curate and continuously improve review artifacts (e.g., strategy review packs, dispersion/performance readouts, trading checklists) to support both initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
• Partner across stakeholders to translate insights into pragmatic enhancements to process, controls, and client outcomes, reinforcing accountability and transparency throughout the program lifecycle.
